rows.title: A germinal products notification picks its transporter from the germinal set's own transporter list
rows.detail: A trader making a germinal products notification has to say who is transporting the consignment, and the germinal journey has no transporter step of its own. The germinal products set gets its own transporter list page, built as a copy of the live animals transporter list in the germinal set and reached at the germinal notification path with the same slug. Transporters belong to the trader's organisation rather than to a set, so the germinal list offers the same transporters a live animals notification offers, and a transporter added on either kind of notification is on the other's list next time. The list has no add pages of its own: its 'Add a transporter' button opens the add-a-transporter pages the address book front door serves, in journey mode, and the trader lands back on the germinal list on save or on cancel.
acceptanceCriteria: In a germinal products notification, the transport step opens a transporter list page headed 'Transporter details', with the intro 'This is the person or company responsible for transporting the consignment.', a 'Search' box hinted 'Name, address or approval number' with a 'Search' button, an 'Add a transporter' button, and a 'Select a transporter' table of radio rows with the columns Name, Address, Approval number, Type and Status and a 'View details' link on each row. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-101; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-001)

The germinal transporter list shows each transporter's type as 'Commercial' or 'Private' and its approval status as 'Approved' or 'New', and says how many are shown, reading '1 transporter shown' for one transporter and '8 transporters shown' for eight. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-102; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-024, repo-frontend-p12-033)

The germinal transporter list shows at most eight transporters a page, with pagination below the table whose links carry the search term and the chosen transporter, no pagination where eight or fewer are found, and an inset between the search box and the table naming the transporter the trader has chosen. (ruling:ian-2026-11-25 ruling-ian-2026-11-25-p1-007, -p1-022, -p1-025, -p1-035-m1)

Where a search leaves no row, the germinal transporter list shows 'No transporters match your search.' in place of the table. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-101; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-033)

Saving the germinal transporter list with no transporter chosen keeps the trader on the list and shows the one error 'Select a transporter from the list', in the error summary and against the list. (confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p2-072, -p2-084, -p2-094; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-044)

The germinal transporter list offers the transporters the address book holds for the signed-in trader's organisation, so a transporter added while making a live animals notification is on the list of that organisation's next germinal products notification, ready to pick, and one added while making a germinal products notification is on its next live animals notification's list. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057; ruling:ian-2026-11-06 ruling-ian-2026-11-06-p1-002; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-029, repo-frontend-p12-061; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p2-072, -p2-084, -p2-094)

From the germinal transporter list, 'Add a transporter' opens the add-a-transporter pages the address book front door serves, in journey mode, and the germinal products set serves no transporter add pages of its own. (ruling:ian-2026-11-06 ruling-ian-2026-11-06-p1-012, -p1-055; ruling:ian-2026-11-06 ruling-ian-2026-11-06-p1-002)

Saving a transporter on those add pages lands the trader back on the germinal transporter list under a success banner titled 'Success' reading '<transporter name> transporter added', with the new transporter in the list ready to pick, and cancelling lands them back on the germinal transporter list with the transporter the notification already had still ticked. (ruling:ian-2026-11-06 ruling-ian-2026-11-06-p1-012; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-056, repo-frontend-p13-092)

Picking a transporter on a germinal products notification and saving keeps it ticked when the trader opens the germinal transporter list again. (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-102; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-042)

A germinal transporter list opened from the germinal notification view keeps that trail: its Back link returns to the view, and a transporter saved from the add pages lands back on that same trailed list. (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p13-092, repo-frontend-p13-096)

The germinal transporter list is at the germinal products notification path followed by the live animals transporter list's slug, so the address book front door's add pages return the trader to it. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p12-001; ruling:ian-2026-11-06 ruling-ian-2026-11-06-p1-012)

rows.notes: One slice, req-1820. Rewrite of the existing row: req-1820 no longer gives the germinal set a copy of the transporter type question or either details form, because the add pages are now the address book front door's and there is nothing of them to copy (ruling:ian-2026-11-06 points 2 and 8). The criterion that the approved commercial transporter register page's slug shows the service's page not found came out with it: req-1820 as it stands names only the transporter list. The paging criterion is the list's own behaviour under ruling:ian-2026-11-25, written here because the germinal list is this row's code; req-2268 sets it on the live-animals list on the transporters branch. Combiner: keep the row in the germinal-products theme and keep its id, and add transporters to that theme's dependsOn - the 'Add a transporter' criteria cannot be observed until the transporters branch has built the transporter hand-off (req-2264), so give this row an externalDependsOn on shared/design-release-2-1/themes/transporters alongside its existing dependsOn on the germinal set's foundation row. The germinal journey type is already registered in the front door's journey registry, so this row changes no front door code.

splitOff.why: It refuses a commercial transporter posted with a blank or non-Northern-Ireland country on the commercial transporter details form, which theme transporters owns (frontend:src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/transport/commercial-transporter-details).

It changes the fields, formats, limits, labels, hints, section heading and question order on both transporter forms, which theme transporters owns (insfrontend:src/server/app/features/address-book/transporter, frontend:.../transport/commercial-transporter-details and .../private-transporter-details, addressbook:src/main/java/uk/gov/defra/trade/imports/addressbook/transporter).

It gives the address book's transporter record its own approval status field and reads 'Approved' or 'New' from it on the transporter list, which theme transporters owns (addressbook:src/main/java/uk/gov/defra/trade/imports/addressbook/transporter, insfrontend:src/server/app/features/address-book/transporter, frontend:.../transport/transporters).

It moves the add-a-transporter pages out of the journey into the address book front door and opens them through the address hand-off, which theme transporters owns (frontend:.../transport/transporter-add, .../private-transporter-details, .../commercial-transporter-details, .../transporter-details-save.js, insfrontend:src/server/app/features/address-book/transporter, tests:page-objects/animals/transporter-add-page.ts).
It labels the name field 'Name or organisation name' on the address book's transporter forms, which theme transporters owns (insfrontend:src/server/app/features/address-book/transporter).

It labels the commercial transporter form's first field 'Transporter authorisation number' on the address book's transporter forms, which theme transporters owns (insfrontend:src/server/app/features/address-book/transporter).
It puts one 'Enter contact details' section heading on the address book's transporter forms, which theme transporters owns (insfrontend:src/server/app/features/address-book/transporter).

It pages the journey's transporter list at eight and adds the chosen-transporter inset, which theme transporters owns (frontend:.../transport/transporters, tests:page-objects/animals/transporter-page.ts).

It matches a saved transporter pick back to its address book record by identifier rather than by name, which theme transporters owns (frontend:.../transport/transporters, frontend:src/server/app/services/transporters).

It proves the transporter list's search, pick and save and both add forms' save and cancel with JavaScript switched off, which theme transporters owns (frontend:.../transport/transporters, .../private-transporter-details, .../commercial-transporter-details, frontend:.../transport/fit).
